fees.label: SEVIS I-901 fee (J-1 exchange visitors, most categories)
fees.note: Source is a DHS fee infographic dated May 2025. The reduced $35 fee applies to au pair, camp counselor, and summer work travel participants, not interns or trainees. Re-check before launch.

fees.label: Nonimmigrant visa application processing fee (MRV), J visa
fees.note: Some nationalities may also owe a visa issuance (reciprocity) fee, which is not included here. Check the State Department fee page for your country.
